name: reduce_sum
summary: y[0] = sum of n f32 elements; OpenCL/CUDA reduce in a 256-wide local tree per block, then one block reduces the block partials

y.why: Recursive summation of n terms in any order (sequential, tree, blocked) is within gamma(n-1)*sum|x_i| of the exact sum (Higham ASNA 2nd ed. eq. 4.4); gamma(n) is used, scale sum|x_i| from reference.py. Padding adds exact zeros. At the default n: WolframLanguageEvaluator: u=2^-24; g[n_]:=n u/(1-n u); N[g[100003],10] -> 0.005996385607; N[g[257],10] -> 0.00001531862836. Control reduce_drop_last checks that one missing element fails.
